annotations.title: RiskModels Residual Returns and Recommended Hedge Depth

description: Use when you need daily residual (stock-specific) returns and the recommended hedge depth (L1 market, L2 sector or L3 subsector) for 1-100 stocks. Not for the full factor split of each day's return (use riskmodels_get_return_attribution) or a mean-reversion signal on a basket (use riskmodels_get_residual_signal). Returns, per ticker, the recommended depth by date, the hedge ratios at that depth and the daily residual return series. One ticker is served by GET /lstar; 2-100 tickers by POST /batch/lstar. Without threshold the depth is the one ERM3 publishes; with threshold it is the simplest depth whose marginal explained risk exceeds the threshold. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: one ticker $0.02 plus $0.01 per year beyond the first; 2-100 tickers $0.015 per ticker plus $0.0075 per ticker per year beyond the first, minimum $0.03 per call.

market_factor_etf.description: ETF ticker used as the market factor, e.g. QQQ (default SPY)

threshold.description: Marginal explained-risk threshold, a fraction, e.g. 0.01. Omit for the depth ERM3 publishes

tickers.description: 1-100 US stock ticker symbols, e.g. ["NVDA"] or ["AAPL","MSFT"]

years.description: Calendar years of daily history, integer 1-15, e.g. 3 (default 1)
